title: Raycast keyboard
description: A full-size, dark keycap keyboard wider than the screen and cropped at both edges: 110px keys with 11px corners and stacked inset highlights, rows staggered like a real keyboard. Keys can hold a feature tile (they fade 0.2 → 1 as they scroll into view) or glow red; a soft breathing glow loops on lit keys.
notes: keys are 110px at every screen size; the board is centred (or left-anchored) and clipped by its parent, so give the parent a height and overflow-clip
tile reveal uses a CSS scroll-driven animation with a static fallback
name: raycast-keyboard

props.name: anchor
props.description: how the board sits in its box: centred (cropped both sides) or anchored left

props.name: dim
props.description: fade the plain keys to about a third so that only the feature tiles read
